claims.sentence: The enrollment contract must specify the type, level, and direction of the educational program (or part of a program of a certain level, type, and/or direction)
It must include the main characteristics of the provided education (educational service)
The contract must state the form of study and the terms for mastering the educational program (duration of study)
It must indicate the type of document issued to the student after successful completion of the corresponding educational program (or part of the program)
The procedure for changing and terminating the contract must be outlined
Other necessary information related to the specifics of the paid educational services provided must also be included

Educational relations may be terminated early at the own desire of the student or the parents (legal representatives) of a minor student, including in the case of the student's transfer to another organization carrying out educational activities
To initiate early termination of educational relations, the student or the parents (legal representatives) of a minor student must apply to the University administration
A personal application to the director for dismissal at the student's own desire
A clearance sheet in the form established by the University
A receipt for payment for education for the corresponding period of study (if applicable)
A student ID card and grade book (if they were issued to the student)

Dismissal of the student at the initiative of the student or the parents (legal representatives) of a minor student is carried out within a period of no more than one month from the moment of submitting the corresponding application
The evidence does not specify the exact content of the "main characteristics of the provided education" or the "other necessary information" beyond stating they must be included
The evidence does not define the specific form of the clearance sheet, only that it is established by the University
The evidence does not detail the procedure for termination by the University's initiative or due to circumstances beyond control, only listing them as valid cases
The evidence does not specify what happens if the student does not have a student ID card or grade book, only that they are required "if they were issued"
